description: This PHP script initializes and populates report configurations in a vtiger CRM system, including report folders, report definitions, columns, modules, filters, and sorting options, and inserts them into the database.

methods.name: PopulateReportFolder
methods.description: Stores report folder name and description into the database.

methods.name: insertSelectQuery
methods.description: Creates a new select query entry in the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: insertSelectColumns
methods.description: Stores selected column names for a report query.

methods.name: insertReports
methods.description: Stores report details into the database.

methods.name: insertReportModules
methods.description: Stores primary and secondary modules associated with a report.

methods.name: insertSortColumns
methods.description: Stores sorting order for report columns.

methods.name: insertStdFilter
methods.description: Stores standard date filters for reports.

methods.name: insertAdvFilter
methods.description: Stores advanced filter criteria for reports.
